Keep semconv 1.45.0, the maintenance/v2.x base, the current ready-for-review state, and the servlet, RabbitMQ and Pulsar fixes already delivered in 89c563036a6c26f53f3ace3d0dec59b1bbe1bebd. Do not create another PR.

The original assignment required preserving maintenance-branch telemetry compatibility. The previous attempt changed AwsLambdaFunctionAttributesExtractor.FAAS_INVOCATION_ID from AttributeKey.stringKey("faas.invocation_id") to AttributeKey.stringKey("faas.invocation.id"). That unconditionally changes production telemetry just to follow a renamed incubating constant in test expectations. The existing aws-lambda-core-1.0/metadata.yaml correctly documents faas.invocation_id.

Restore the production Lambda key to faas.invocation_id. Fix the root cause of the AWS Lambda test mismatches by pinning affected assertions to this intentionally retained legacy key instead of importing the renamed FaasIncubatingAttributes.FAAS_INVOCATION_ID. For example, AwsLambdaStreamHandlerTest imports that constant and its handlerTraced assertion at line 73 follows its new spelling. Find every affected Lambda core, events and shared test use, including library and javaagent coverage, so default and latest-dependency runs consistently verify the actual preserved key. Prefer AttributeKey.stringKey("faas.invocation_id") directly in concise assertions; do not expose production internals or add an abstraction solely to compute a short expected key. Keep exact-attribute assertions so an unintended faas.invocation.id emission is caught.

Do not add a new compatibility flag, emit both keys, rename documentation to justify a behavior change, disable tests, weaken assertions, or change intended production behavior. With the production rename removed, the existing metadata remains accurate and no breaking-change migration is needed. Leave review replies and thread resolution to the coordinator.

Run the narrow relevant formatter and AWS Lambda tests with default and latest dependencies, including the affected javaagent/library/event suites and existing compatibility modes where applicable. The user explicitly excludes the Lambda invocation key when no separate deprecated constant preserves its underscore spelling. Keep semconv 1.45.0, maintenance/v2.x, the current ready-for-review state, and all previously delivered CI fixes. Do not create another PR.

Verified against semantic-conventions-java v1.45.0: EnduserIncubatingAttributes.ENDUSER_ID is deprecated but still stringKey("enduser.id"); MessagingIncubatingAttributes.MESSAGING_SYSTEM is deprecated but still stringKey("messaging.system"); MESSAGING_RABBITMQ_DESTINATION_ROUTING_KEY is deprecated but still stringKey("messaging.rabbitmq.destination.routing_key"); MESSAGING_RABBITMQ_MESSAGE_DELIVERY_TAG is deprecated but still longKey("messaging.rabbitmq.message.delivery_tag"). These exactly match the locally copied keys added by this PR. The PR's custom-checks/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/customchecks/OtelDeprecatedApiUsage.java explicitly supports @SuppressWarnings("deprecation"), including static imports.

Restore use of those existing semconv constants wherever this PR newly copied them and direct imports are permitted: remove the new private ENDUSER_ID copy in servlet-common/javaagent/BaseServletHelper.java and restore its static import; replace RabbitSemconvAttributes imports in the five RabbitMQ javaagent callers with the corresponding MessagingIncubatingAttributes imports, then remove the now-unnecessary RabbitSemconvAttributes.java file; restore the MESSAGING_SYSTEM import in aws-lambda-events-2.2/testing/AwsLambdaSqsMetricsAssertions.java instead of its newly inlined stringKey("messaging.system") assertions. Add @SuppressWarnings("deprecation") with a succinct current-code explanation for intentionally retained legacy semconv, scoped to the smallest practical existing method, field, or class. Do not add helper methods just to host suppressions, disable the checker, or change global build settings.

Preserve the repository's library-production rule: incubating constants there remain locally copied, not directly imported. In particular leave AwsLambdaFunctionAttributesExtractor's local faas.invocation_id key and all corrected Lambda test assertions unchanged. FaasIncubatingAttributes.FAAS_INVOCATION_ID now maps to faas.invocation.id and no separate deprecated underscore-key constant exists, so it cannot replace the preserved key. Do not migrate any telemetry key, emit duplicate keys, introduce compatibility flags, undo the test fixes or other deprecation suppressions, or make unrelated cleanup.

Acceptance criteria: available deprecated constants replace the new local copies only where key name and type match and repository rules permit imports; unused added holder code is removed; emitted telemetry and every legacy/preview/messaging mode remain unchanged; semconv remains 1.45.0; focused formatting, compilation and relevant servlet, RabbitMQ and AWS Lambda coverage pass with the deprecation checker enabled, including relevant compatibility modes and latest-dependency coverage where applicable. Commit and push the cleanup to this PR's existing branch. Leave review replies and thread resolution to the coordinator.
